title: Superposition and the Hadamard Gate
summary: The states |+⟩ and |−⟩ and a quantum random number generator.
mission: Build a quantum random number generator: put qubit 0 in a uniform superposition and measure it into classical bit 0.
hints: The Hadamard gate takes |0⟩ to the state |+⟩, on the equator of the sphere: qc.h(0).
To read the result, measure the qubit and store the value in a classical bit: qc.measure(qubit, bit).
The solution has two lines: qc.h(0) and then qc.measure(0, 0).

prediction.question: You prepare the state |+⟩ and measure. Then you repeat the experiment from scratch, 1000 times. What do you expect to see?
options: An intermediate value, such as 0.5, in every measurement
prediction.explanation: Each measurement returns only 0 or 1, never an intermediate value. The superposition shows up in the statistics: each outcome half of the time.
